title: Gender Bias in English-to-Greek Machine Translation

bias_targets.methodology: Translating a manually crafted dataset (GendEL) of gender-ambiguous and unambiguous English sentences featuring stereotypical occupational nouns and adjectives into Greek using commercial MT systems (Google Translate, DeepL) and an LLM (GPT-4o). The outputs are then manually annotated for gender representations (masculine, feminine, neutral) and analyzed for male default bias, occupational stereotyping, and errors in anti-stereotypical gender assignments.
